title: Ringel self-duality of hereditary algebras via Auslander-Reiten theory
summary: Highest weight categories with finitely many simples correspond to quasi-hereditary algebras. Ringel duality shows that, up to Morita equivalence, quasi-hereditary algebras come in pairs, while Ringel self-duality is the phenomenon in which a quasi-hereditary algebra is paired with itself. The main purpose of this paper is to show that there are connected non-semisimple hereditary algebras that are Ringel self-dual and to give a combinatorial interpretation of Ringel self-duality in terms of Auslander-Reiten theory.
